Do not include secrets, credentials, private user data, or exploit details that would create additional risk.

## Risk

Describe the affected boundary.

## Impact

What could an attacker or malformed model/tool output cause?

## Reproduction or evidence

Provide the minimum safe evidence needed to investigate.

## Mitigation

Known containment or architectural mitigation, if any.

## Verification

How should the fix be demonstrated?
